item.title: Beyond the broken glass: The human cost of the 1938 November Pogrom
item.description: On his way to school in Vienna on the morning of 10 November 1938, eight-year-old Arthur Schneier watched his synagogue burn while firefighters and police officers stood by “rejoicing”.
